author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was a very tall, heavy condensed HBO whose O was a straight-sided pill, reading as HB0 (zero). Now the wordmark is shorter (HRECT_M), the B has rounded half-elliptical bowls, and the O is a true ellipse. Letter widths are still limited by the 8-unit spacing (H 8, B 6, O 8 across 40 units).
omissions: the reference's wide round O (would need 16 units; only 8 remain after H and B at 8 spacing)
